tagline: A real IDE in your pocket
brief: VibeIDE is a VS Code-style IDE for Android with a real Linux sandbox on the device and an AI agent whose edits you review before they land. The mark should feel like an AI-era product (a friendly, minimal sign) while staying in the app's own palette.
criteria: Success: minimal and ownable like the AI marks the team admires, built on the app's #0078D4 accent, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed.

concepts.name: Flock
concepts.idea: Three chevrons chasing each other around one centre: you, the AI and your code, moving as one.
rationale: Rotational, living mark in the family of modern AI brand marks
Built entirely on the app's accent blue #0078D4
Arc-and-capsule geometry: one width, one radius, 120° symmetry
Heavier small-size cut keeps the gaps open at 16 px

recommendation: Flock: chosen direction. Symbol, lockups, app icons and web icons are delivered in docs/brand.
next_steps: Swap the Android launcher icon for the new app icon
Use the reversed lockup on dark surfaces (README, releases)
Run a trademark search before commercial use
